title: Taking Regular Breaks at Work
paragraphs: Zain bekerja di meja selama berjam-jam. Menjelang tengah hari, kepala dan lehernya sering sakit. Ia mengira hal itu normal karena pekerjaannya sibuk. Dalam ceramah kesehatan perusahaan, ia mendengar satu ide sederhana. Ia dapat berdiri dan meregangkan tubuh selama lima menit setiap jam. Awalnya, Zain merasa terlalu sibuk untuk melakukannya. Ia mencoba jeda singkat selama satu minggu. Pada sore hari, ia merasa lebih segar dan lebih jarang sakit kepala. Perubahannya kecil, tetapi membantunya.

Sekarang Zain memasang alarm pelan di ponselnya setiap jam. Ia berjalan ke jendela, mengisi botol air, atau meregangkan punggung dan bahunya. Zain menceritakan kebiasaan itu kepada rekan kerjanya. Kebiasaan ini memakai sedikit waktu, tetapi membantunya merasa lebih baik saat bekerja.
answerKey: Zain works at a desk for many hours. By the middle of the day, his head and neck often hurt. He thinks this is normal because his job is busy. At a company health talk, he hears one simple idea. He can stand up and stretch for five minutes every hour. At first, Zain thinks he is too busy for this. He tries short breaks for one week. In the afternoon, he feels more awake and notices fewer headaches. The change is small, but it helps him. Now Zain sets a quiet alarm on his phone each hour. He walks to the window, fills his water bottle, or stretches his back and shoulders. Zain tells his coworkers about the habit. It takes very little time, but it helps him feel better during his workday.
